implementation_summary: CONTEXT.md: Skipped Page gains depth-limit, excluded and payment with one-line meanings (and 'never a clean result'); ten new terms with _Avoid_ lists (Website Audit, Page Content, Section, Audit Document naming Structure/Content/Findings/Improvement Roadmap/Proposal, Improvement Roadmap explicitly never a Plan, Pitch Glimpse, Shared Link, Owner Audit, Shortlist, Helper), grounded in DEC-001/005/006/007/009 and answers Q-01, Q-05, Q-09, Q-10, Q-11, Q-13, Q-14, Q-15, Q-17, Q-19, Q-22, Q-23, Q-30, Q-31, Q-34, Q-35, Q-37.
